the SINS is a reliable and valid instrument for assessing stress among nursing students in Hong-Kong.

the psychometric structure obtained from the SINS in a sample of nursing students in a Hong Kong cohort is different from that previously reported for nursing students in the United States, but is similar to the structure obtained in a separate cohort in Hong Kong.

the psychometric structure and reliability of the SINS is stable across a two-year period in nursing students and is consistent with a previously derived factor structure in a separate sample of nursing students.
